base:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Project: KeepXClean, a browser extension that locally filters X feeds and replies using transparent rules, with optional crowd reports.
Visual system: restrained, shipping-quality LIGHT desktop product UI, quiet and precise, content-first, like a carefully crafted reading utility. User explicitly requires LIGHT BACKGROUNDS throughout. Existing brand emerald is retained with accessible darker contrast. Page background #F7F9F8, white navigation #FFFFFF, white panels #FFFFFF, subtle borders #E1E7E3, primary text #172B24, secondary #607168, emerald #13865F for enabled/selected and buttons, pale selected fill #EAF6EF, amber #9B6816 on #FFF6DF for caution, coral #B54747 on #FFF0EE only for errors/destructive actions. Almost all pixels should be white or very pale neutral. No black or charcoal panels. Buttons may be dark emerald with white text. No gradients, glow, glassmorphism, decorative 3D, stock illustrations, massive marketing headlines, or gratuitous charts. Simple thin-line shield/check brand symbol and consistent 1.5px line icons, no emoji. Rounded corners 10–12px, compact 8px spacing rhythm, ample negative space. Realistic readable Simplified Chinese UI typography, Noto Sans SC / PingFang style; Latin brand word KeepXClean spelled exactly. High quality flat front-on screenshot, no devices, no perspective, no external drop-shadow scene, no watermark.
All visible metrics and people are fictional example data. Never label ordinary accounts as definitely fraudulent/bots; state observable reasons neutrally. No claim of verified identities, 100% safety, anonymity guarantees, or live sync success without contextual state. Do not expose GraphQL/Workers/D1/R2 in normal user UI.
Desktop settings shell, whenever present: left sidebar with KeepXClean, a tiny green shield, and five items exactly "过滤规则", "关键词", "黑白名单", "拦截记录", "偏好设置". Sidebar footer "v0.1.0". Main content has top breadcrumb "控制台", quiet status "已保存到本机", and global master toggle "净空已开启". Consistent positions, typography, colors throughout the set.

Asset type: 01 / desktop settings main screen, visual anchor for the entire UI set.

Next a compact horizontal strip "拦截方式" and two real segmented controls "直接隐藏" and "折叠提示", select "折叠提示". To the side small text link "查看示例".
Below use a single clean bordered list with seven separated rule rows, each with a thin monochrome icon, label, precise one-line summary, ON switch, and small expansion chevron. Exact rows:
"高频发帖" / "日均超过 45 条 · 1 小时内刷到超过 8 条"
"社区拉黑记录" / "达到 3 次记录 · 高粉账号采用更高门槛"
"关键词过滤" / "匹配正文、简介、昵称与链接" / small link "管理词库"
"蓝标回复" / "仅在评论区 · 粉丝少于 500"
"标签堆砌" / "# 标签超过 5 个 · $ 标签超过 3 个"
"账号质量" / "注册不足 7 天 · 默认头像 · 关注比例"
"推广广告" / "隐藏标记为推广的内容".
Bottom two inline preference rows with green checks: "保留我关注的账号" and "访问个人主页时仅显示提示". Quiet footnote "误拦截？可在拦截记录中加入白名单。"
Must look like a real finished extension settings page, not a presentation poster. No fake giant analytics. Desktop density is moderate, horizontally aligned controls, meticulous hierarchy. Render Chinese accurately.
